user.title: Somfy RTS transmitter
user.description: Connect to the pigpio daemon that drives your 433.42 MHz transmitter.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to pigpiod. Check that it is running and reachable.

user.title: Add a virtual remote
user.description: Each shutter needs its own remote. Keep the suggested id for a new shutter, or enter the id and next rolling code of a remote you are migrating from another controller (up to {max_remote_id}).

reconfigure.title: Edit remote
reconfigure.description: Remote id {remote_id}. The id cannot be changed, and the rolling code can only be raised: a lower code would unpair the motor. Raise it only to recover, for example after restoring an old backup.

error.remote_id_in_use: Another remote already uses this id.
error.rolling_code_lower: The rolling code can only be raised, never lowered.
